g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Average time spent in a 24-hour day by people aged 15 to 64. Based on each

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: country's most recent time-use survey in the OECD data, from 2010 to 2024.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Figures are averaged across everyone aged 15 to 64, including people who don't work or study, and across all days of the week. The OECD groups

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: each country's survey activities into common categories, but differences between the surveys can still affect comparisons.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Data source: OECD Time Use Database (2026)

text.style: font-size: 7.729339px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: OurWorldinData.org — Research and data to make progress against the world's largest problems.
